caseName: Standard Oil Co. v. Federal Trade Commission
caseNameFull: Standard Oil Company of California v. Federal Trade Commission Mobil Oil Corp. v. Federal Trade Commission and Texaco Inc. v. Federal Trade Commission
judges: Consideration, Motion, Petitions, Stewart, Took, White

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of the Chamber of Commerce of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice White, and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.
